generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to grasp the green cucumber on the white circular surface and lift it clear of the tabletop. It carries the cucumber over the lower tier of the black wire basket, opens its fingers, and releases it into the basket, leaving its right hand open above it. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The cucumber has been released into the lower black wire basket and is still moving against its base wires. The right hand is open above and to the right of it, and the left hand remains open without contact.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: approaches, encloses and grasps cucumber, lifts and transports it, then opens to release it into lower basket.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open hand remains near the lower basket's left side, with small positional changes but no visible object grasp or basket stabilization.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer, bimanual support, or interaction with the background person.

uncertainties: The cucumber is still shifting within the lower basket in the final frames; its later fully settled orientation is not shown. Exact individual finger contact points are partly obscured during grasp, although the secure lift and later release are visible.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
